_note: インスタント麺の系譜。品目ハブ（/en/eat/instant-noodles/）の表と各系譜ページがここから描く。出典は docs/research/instant-noodles-2026-10-13.md と各系譜ページの sources。地域ではなく形（袋／カップ）で分けている
name: Instant noodles
nameJa: インスタント麺（即席めん）

cells.format: A dried noodle block in a packet; the first was pre-seasoned, and a separate soup sachet became standard from 1962
cells.noodle: Fried, or non-fried (hot-air dried) from 1968; one packet is about 80 strands averaging about 65 cm
cells.prep: Chicken Ramen today: 400 ml of hot water poured on for 3 minutes, or simmered for 1 minute
cells.regional: Regional packets from 1979 (Umakacchan for Kyushu); a four-city series in 1983

lineages.name: Cup noodles (Cup Noodle)
lineages.nameJa: カップ麺（カップヌードル）

cells.format: A cup that is package, cooker and bowl; foamed polystyrene or paper-based; first sold with a fork
cells.noodle: In Cup Noodle the block is held in the middle of the cup so hot water circulates underneath
cells.prep: Lid half open, boiling water to the inside line, about 3 minutes (Cup Noodle 280 ml); some cups use cold water
cells.regional: Donbei sold separately in eastern and western Japan; four regional Akai Kitsune broths; cup Okinawa soba sold only in Okinawa
